name: Scout
description: A fast, lightly armored unit ideal for early game exploration. High vision range and speed but minimal combat ability.

designGoals: Large vision range for scouting enemy positions

strengths: 8.0 movement speed (fastest unit in early game)

gameplay.counters: Effective scouts can kite slower units but will lose to any combat-focused unit
gameplay.synergy: Works well with ranged units for vision and archer units for protection
